 Multi-Sport Parlay for Thursday, Nov 5th: NBA & NHL Predictions 
 by Jeff Fox  November 5, 2026 
 We’re at a busy time in the sports calendar, with lots of different sports to watch and bet on. So let’s mix our genres up a bit and build a winning parlay. Tonight, let’s hit the ice and the hardwood. Here is your winning Multi-Sport Parlay for Thursday, Nov 5th: NBA & NHL Predictions.
 Multi-Sport Parlay for Thursday, Nov 5th: NBA & NHL Predictions 
 Chicago Blackhawks vs Tampa Bay Lightning 
 Start Time – 7:00 PM   EST 
 With this being my first stab at a multi-sport parlay column, I’m going to ease into it and make a fairly easy play for tonight. Easy money, that is.
 The easiest money half of our parlay takes place at the rink down in Tampa, as the Tampa Bay Lightning host the Chicago Blackhawks. The Blackhawks are 0-6-1 on the road this season, while the Lightning are 7-0-0 , playing in front of their home fans at the Benchmark International Arena – enough analysis.
 Miami Heat vs Golden State Warriors 
 Start Time – 10:00 PM   EST 
 The tougher half of our play takes place in San Francisco, with the Golden State Warriors hosting the Miami Heat. But the Heat are really struggling to integrate Giannis Antetokounmpo into the lineup.
 And the Warriors are surprisingly good, winning five straight after coming out of the gate 0-3.
 Multi-Sport Parlay Play: Tampa Bay ML + Golden State ML (-107)
